sources.title: LFCA Program Changes
sources.notes: DISPUTED. States 'The LFCA domains will remain unchanged but please review the upcoming changes to competencies... which are outlined below each domain heading.' Two problems, both verified in a browser on 2026-08-09. (1) No per-domain change outlines exist on the page; whole-page text is 2,556 characters and stops at the 22 competency names. (2) The claim that domains are unchanged is contradicted by the Linux Foundation's own archived certification page (see wayback-lfca-2025-08): all six domain weights changed, and the domain 'Supporting Applications and Developers' (8%) was renamed to 'IT Project Management Fundamentals' (10%). This project records the archived evidence rather than the page's claim, and documents the disagreement here rather than silently choosing.

sources.title: Linux Foundation Certified IT Associate (LFCA)
sources.notes: Canonical current syllabus. The Domains & Competencies accordion is JS-rendered and requires a browser, but it contains only domain names, weights and the 22 competency names: fully expanding it adds zero characters (container text is 1,930 characters either way, verified 2026-08-09). This is the basis for recording competency name as the finest published objective granularity.

sources.title: Fundamentals of Open Source IT and Cloud Computing (LFS200) — course content
sources.notes: Authenticated course content, read via the repository owner's own enrolment. 12 sections, 47 lessons, 158,185 characters of instructional text. Course structure still reflects the pre-2025-09-16 syllabus: the chapter is named 'Supporting Applications and Developers' (a domain renamed in 2025) and it retains lessons for 'Deployment Environments' and 'Network Security' (competencies removed in 2025). Six current competencies have no lesson at all. Coverage analysis and measured term absences are recorded in research/lfs200-notes/00-course-map.md. Course prose is not reproduced in this repository.

sources.title: LFCA certification page, archived snapshot (pre-2025-09-16 syllabus)
sources.notes: Snapshot of the Linux Foundation's own certification page before the 2025-09-16 update. Sole evidence for the previous domain weights and competency names, and therefore the basis for every sept_2025_status value in data/competencies.json. Tier 1 because the archived content is the Linux Foundation's own published text; the Internet Archive is the transport, not the author.

sources.title: Linux Foundation Certification Exam: Candidate Handbook (PSI BRIDGE)
sources.notes: Generic across all Linux Foundation exams; covers proctoring logistics, not LFCA objectives. Page footer reports last update roughly two years ago. Checked during stage 1 while searching for a finer syllabus; contains none.

sources.title: Fundamentals of Open Source IT and Cloud Computing (LFS200)
sources.notes: Public overview page. Course content itself requires authenticated access.

sources.title: Multiple Choice Exams: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.notes: Generic FAQ across all LF multiple-choice-format exams (LFCA is one of them, confirmed via lf-lfca-cert-page labelling LFCA a 'Multiple Choice Exam'). Source for stage 2 exam mechanics: 90-minute duration, 75% passing score, remote proctoring description, 24-hour automated scoring turnaround, 2-year certification validity, renewal mechanics, ID requirements. Does not state a question count; defers pricing questions to the training catalog.

sources.title: Multiple Choice Exams: Important Instructions
sources.notes: Generic instructions across LF multiple-choice exams. Source for proctoring platform detail (PSI Bridge, PSI Secure Browser), system/testing-location requirements, ID requirements, and the sanctioned-countries list. No question count or per-question format detail. Links to a page at /tc-docs/certification/faq-lfca which returned HTTP 404 when checked 2026-08-09 -- dead link, not used as a source.

sources.title: LFCA Sample Curriculum Path (PDF)
sources.notes: One-page infographic listing suggested free/paid preparatory courses and a rough 3-6 month self-paced prep estimate; explicitly states no course is a prerequisite for the exam. Consulted for stage 2 exam mechanics but yielded nothing on question count, duration, price, or scoring -- recorded here so it is not re-checked.

sources.title: LFCA Free Resources
sources.notes: Landing page linking to free introductory courses (Introduction to Linux, etc.). Consulted for stage 2 exam mechanics but contains no exam logistics or scoring content -- recorded here so it is not re-checked.
